_readme: Reviewed manual corrections for foreign issuers' Form 4 lines (api/_lib/fpiNormalize.js). Keyed by ticker. ratio = home-market shares per ONE US-listed security; cur = the currency the issuer's insiders report in; count = "home" when the issuer's insiders report a price per ADS with the share count in home-market units. An entry fills in only when the SEC documents (F-6 / 20-F) and the market-derived ratio give nothing; add "force": true to make it win over them. Always cite the source.

CX.source: CEMEX insiders file CPO counts at the ADS price: the 2026-08-19 sale of 21,268 ADSs was filed as 212,680 CPOs at $10.68 "per ADS"; the 20-F: "each ADS representing ten CPOs".

SVRE.source: SaverOne 20-F (2026-03-27): "American Depositary Shares, each representing 43,200 ordinary shares" — fpi.json read it as 43.2 before the thousands separator was parsed.
